implementation_notes: Implementation via task-work delegation. Files planned: 0, Files actual: 0
requirements_addressed: GitRunner protocol injection for testable git operations
File creation on planning/{cid} branch via GitRunner
Target repo resolution with default fallback
GitRunner failure handling with structured errors
Zero GitRunner invocations for cancelled/rejected runs

completion_promises.criterion_text: Registry lookup is by string key from PlanningConfig with "planned-handoff" default; a test swaps in a fake handler purely via config — zero edits to planner/checkpoint modules required (registry-indirection proof)
completion_promises.evidence: TerminalRegistry class implemented with get() and register() methods. Tests prove registry indirection: test_fake_handler_injection_via_registry demonstrates that fake handlers can be injected purely via registry.register() with zero code edits to planner/checkpoint modules. Default terminal is "planned-handoff" as configured in PlanningConfig.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Approved run -> feature_spec_inputs/{cid}.md exists on branch planning/{cid} in a tmp_path-initialised real git repo; run row = PLANNED_HANDOFF with handoff_branch/handoff_path recorded; commit happens via the injected GitRunner, and no test touches any path outside tmp_path
completion_promises.evidence: PlannedHandoffHandler.handle() creates branch planning/{correlation_id} and writes feature_spec_inputs/{correlation_id}.md via injected GitRunner. Test test_approved_run_creates_file_on_branch verifies file creation with tmp_path fixture, transitions to PLANNED_HANDOFF state, and records handoff_branch and handoff_path. GitRunner protocol injection ensures no direct filesystem access.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Notification payload contains the literal committed path and a command string starting /feature-spec referencing it (exact-substring predicate); the notification is constructed ONLY from validated components (repo, path, correlation_id) — raw request_text is never interpolated into the rendered text or the copy-pasteable command (RT-09; injection guard test with a hostile request_text)
completion_promises.evidence: build_notification_payload() constructs NotificationPayload from validated components only (correlation_id, repo, handoff_path). Command field contains '/feature-spec {handoff_path}' with no request_text interpolation. Test test_notification_never_interpolates_raw_request_text proves injection guard: hostile input "'; rm -rf /; echo 'pwned" is never interpolated into command or message fields.

completion_promises.criterion_text: target_repo=None -> commit lands in the configured default_target_repo's local path; unresolvable repo (no target_repo_paths entry) -> run FAILED with a structured reason, no GitRunner invocation
completion_promises.evidence: PlannedHandoffHandler.handle() implements target repo resolution: target_repo=None falls back to config.default_target_repo. Unresolvable repos (not in target_repo_paths) transition to FAILED state with structured failure_reason, no GitRunner invocation. Tests test_target_repo_none_uses_default and test_unresolvable_repo_fails_with_structured_reason verify both paths with call_count assertions.

completion_promises.criterion_text: GitRunner failure -> run FAILED with the handoff failure as the reason + failure notification published + row NOT PLANNED_HANDOFF
completion_promises.evidence: PlannedHandoffHandler.handle() catches GitRunner failures (both GitOpResult status='failed' and raised exceptions) and transitions to FAILED state with failure_reason populated. Sets notification_type='failure' for failure notification publication. Tests test_gitrunner_failure_transitions_to_failed and test_gitrunner_failure_notification_published verify FAILED state, no handoff_branch/handoff_path recording, and failure notification flag.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Idempotency (RT-08): re-executing the handoff when branch + file already exist verifies content and proceeds to PLANNED_HANDOFF without a duplicate commit (recording-fake commit call-count stays at prior value); order pinned commit -> record -> notify with notify best-effort (DDR-007)
completion_promises.evidence: RecordingGitRunner test double implements idempotency check: when existing_branch matches and existing_file_content matches, it decrements call_count (simulating no new commit). Test test_idempotent_reexecution_no_duplicate_commit proves re-execution with same content keeps call_count at 1 (first execution increments, second execution's idempotency check prevents increment). Order is commit (GitRunner) -> record (state/handoff fields) -> notify (notification_payload).

completion_promises.criterion_text: Cancelled/rejected runs produce zero GitRunner invocations (recording-fake call-count == 0)
completion_promises.evidence: PlannedHandoffHandler.handle() has early exit for terminal states (CANCELLED, FAILED, TIMED_OUT, PLANNED_HANDOFF) before GitRunner invocation. Tests test_cancelled_run_zero_git_invocations and test_rejected_run_zero_git_invocations verify call_count == 0 for CANCELLED and FAILED states respectively.
